sections.title: Improved bounds for Szpiro's conjecture
sections.abstract: Improves the unconditional elliptic-curve bound from log Delta << N log N to log Delta << N log log N and proves log Delta << N for semistable curves.
sections.claimed_result: The author claims these stronger unconditional bounds using methods related to Shimura curves and the abc conjecture.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: Elliptic curves over Q; Delta is the minimal discriminant and N the conductor; semistability is required for the linear bound.
sections.caveat: Fresh arXiv preprint; proof and relation to the abc approach require expert checking.

sections.title: Proof of the singularity conjecture for discrete subgroups of SL_2(R)
sections.abstract: Proves singularity of the stationary measure on P^1(R) relative to SO(2)-invariant measure in the discrete Zariski-dense SL_2(R) setting.
sections.claimed_result: The author claims the conjecture using winding variances on finite covers of a closed hyperbolic surface and a topological obstruction.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: Finitely supported measure whose support generates a Zariski-dense discrete subgroup.
sections.caveat: The conclusion is limited to the stated discrete Zariski-dense hypotheses.

sections.title: An Alon-Boppana Bound for the Non-Backtracking Operator
sections.abstract: Gives a lower bound on fixed-index non-backtracking eigenvalue moduli for graph families with a unimodular Galton-Watson local limit and proves a conjecture for Erdős-Rényi graphs.
sections.claimed_result: Under local convergence and an exponential-moment condition, |lambda_k(B)| >= sqrt(kappa)-o_N(1), via Bethe-Hessian and effective-conductance arguments.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: kappa=E[D(D-1)]/E[D] > 1; N is the vertex count.
sections.caveat: Finite-size constants and extensions beyond the stated degree-tail assumptions are not given in the abstract.

sections.title: Uncountably many local isomorphism types of compactly generated simple groups
sections.abstract: Claims continuum-many local-isomorphism classes among non-discrete compactly generated totally disconnected locally compact topologically simple groups.
sections.claimed_result: The authors claim 2^aleph_0 local-isomorphism classes, answering an explicitly stated open question.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: Groups are non-discrete, compactly generated, totally disconnected, locally compact, and topologically simple.
sections.caveat: This is an overview of a forthcoming paper; the full proof is important for assessment.

sections.title: Mass gap for the hierarchical sinh-Gordon model
sections.abstract: Proves infinite-volume existence, a uniform log-Sobolev inequality, and a mass gap for the hierarchical sinh-Gordon model for b^2 in (0,1).
sections.claimed_result: The authors claim these results, with a simpler regime for b^2 in (0,1/2), and raise questions about physics conjectures.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: Hierarchical massless Gaussian free field with cosh interaction, parameterized by b^2.
sections.caveat: Hierarchical results do not automatically establish corresponding continuum-field claims.

sections.title: Renormalizing small ball events for branching random walk
sections.abstract: Shows that small-ball conditioning of branching random walk yields endpoint correlation length O(r), using renormalization-group analysis.
sections.claimed_result: The author claims the optimal O(r) bound and applications to sinh-Gordon and generalized phi^4 models.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: Depth-n branching random walk with standard Gaussian increments conditioned on endpoints lying in an interval of radius r.
sections.caveat: Applications depend on the relevant confining-potential hypotheses.

sections.title: Global existence and vanishing viscosity limit of the compressible Navier-Stokes-Vlasov-Fokker-Planck system in critical spaces
sections.abstract: Claims global strong solutions near equilibrium and a global-in-time vanishing-viscosity limit for coupled fluid-particle systems in critical Besov spaces.
sections.claimed_result: The authors claim uniform estimates for viscosity epsilon and convergence at rate O(epsilon), plus decay estimates.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: Near-equilibrium critical Besov data, with an additional lower-order Besov assumption for optimal decay.
sections.caveat: Near-equilibrium and regularity assumptions exclude an automatic large-data conclusion.

sections.title: Chern bounds and tangent geometry of polarized Calabi-Yau threefolds
sections.abstract: Uses jet bundles, tangent geometry, and projective duality to derive improved bounds for polarized Calabi-Yau threefolds.
sections.claimed_result: Claims a Chern-number inequality, improved Hodge-number bounds, a P^6 degree bound of 39, and tangent-variety normalization for m>=2.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: Calabi-Yau threefold X with very ample polarization H; d=H^3; P^6 result concerns nondegenerate embeddings.
sections.caveat: Tangent degree 1 for m=1 is conjectural and verified only for several families.
